Subject: Renewal + expansion: adding EU region & increased commitment

Hey Mateo,

Quick note from procurement and the infra team — OrbitHealth is ready to move forward on the 24-month renewal, but we want to increase committed capacity by ~35% and enable the service in eu-west-1 in addition to us-east-1. Procurement asked a few operational questions before we sign:

- Can you confirm a single Private Offer can cover both regions (us-east-1 + eu-west-1) or do we need two offers?
- How will invoicing work across regions (VAT in EU)?
- We need a clear acceptance window / staged activation plan so our SREs can test in EU before full traffic shift.
- Any docs we need to include with the PO (SOC2 evidence, IP/EULA notes)?

I've CC'd procurement. They prefer a staggered billing plan (tranche invoices) if possible. We can attach the PO once we have the acceptance steps.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call.

Tom Brennan
Head of Infrastructure
OrbitHealth

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: adding EU region & increased commitment

Tom — thanks, and great to hear OrbitHealth is moving forward. High level answers up front:

- Single private offer: AWS supports a single Private Offer that can include multiple regional AMIs/regions; however acceptance/invoicing is per-account and region-specific billing/ VAT needs to be addressed in the PO. We usually map a single PO to a single private-offer ID and then specify the regions in the contract appendix.
- Invoicing: we can provide EU VAT-compliant invoices for the eu-west-1 usage. We'll coordinate with finance for VAT registration notes and include a billing contact on the private offer.
- Staged activation: propose a 3-step plan — (1) EU staging acceptance (48–72h smoke test), (2) soft traffic shift (10% for 7 days), (3) full cutover. Acceptance gating: successful inference latency & throughput tests + no data-plane errors.
- Attachments: please include signed PO PDF and we will attach SOC2 summary (we can provide full evidence on NDA if needed).

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement shares signed PO (PDF) — include billing contact + VAT info.
2) Redwood creates Private Offer and shares AWS Marketplace link & offer ID.
3) Orbit accepts offer (procurement completes acceptance).
4) Redwood and Orbit run EU staging window and confirm cutover.

Marissa — looping you in to handle the private-offer creation and acceptance windows. Hannah, can you confirm billing/tranche options and legal's preferred invoice language?

I'll hold a 30-min sync for Thursday if that helps.

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: OrbitHealth private offer setup — steps & timeline

Hi team —

Per Mateo/Tom, here are the operational steps I will execute and the timelines we expect:

1) Private Offer creation (Redwood) — target: 24 hours
   - I will create a single Private Offer (ID: FAKE-OFFER-ID-12345) that enumerates both us-east-1 and eu-west-1 SKUs. The offer will include the upgraded commit (35% uplift) and the 24-month term.

2) Acceptance window — OrbitHealth will be given a 14-day window in the AWS console to accept the Private Offer. We recommend acceptance + billing contact in the first 3 business days to avoid delays.

3) Staged activation plan — EU staging: 48–72h smoke; soft traffic shift (7d at 10%); cutover after metrics pass. I will provision a test endpoint and share keys for their SREs.

4) Billing / Invoicing options — we can support tranche invoicing: initial invoice on acceptance (prorated first month), monthly invoices thereafter; for EU VAT we will flag invoices with VAT line items and bill to the EU billing contact provided on the PO. Hannah, please confirm if Redwood finance requires any extra fields on the PO.

5) Compliance docs — I will attach SOC2 summary and a link to our security pack. If Orbit needs the full pack for procurement review, we can provide it under NDA.

Action items:
- Tom/procurement: upload signed PO (PDF) in reply and provide EU billing contact + VAT registration number.
- Hannah: confirm tranche invoicing template and send required PO fields.
- AWS Marketplace Ops: if there are any region-specific constraints on acceptance, flag here.

Marissa Cole
